issue_context.title: Configurable TiDB version and banner for OEM and enterprise release
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement

To produce different releases with different versions and banners, we have to modify the version and banner, then recompile TiDB.

It is better if the version and banner are configurable. With one compiling, different releases could be produced.

review_comments:
Usually when we update `config.go`, [`config.toml.example`](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/master/config/config.toml.example) is updated at the same time.

But this case is a little special since it is meaningless for most of the users. IMHO it doesn't have to be listed in example file.
